comments.author: lolyu
comments.body:
the issue is because that the SONiC is not that responsive to the neighbor solicitation
```
# tcpdump -i Vlan1000 -nevtt "icmp6 && (ip6[40] == 135 || ip6[40] == 136)"
1638182020.188376 98:03:9b:03:22:04 > 33:33:ff:00:00:03, ethertype IPv6 (0x86dd), length 86: (hlim 255, next-header ICMPv6 (58) payload length: 32) fe80::9a03:9bff:fe03:2204 > ff02::1:ff00:3: [icmp6 sum ok] ICMP6, neighbor solicitation, length 32, who has fc02:1000::3
          source link-address option (1), length 8 (1): 98:03:9b:03:22:04
1638182026.543485 d4:af:f7:0f:95:0c > 98:03:9b:03:22:04, ethertype IPv6 (0x86dd), length 86: (flowlabel 0x5b6cd, hlim 255, next-header ICMPv6 (58) payload length: 32) fe80::d6af:f7ff:fe0f:950c > fe80::9a03:9bff:fe03:2204: [icmp6 sum ok] ICMP6, neighbor advertisement, length 32, tgt is fc02:1000::3, Flags [router, solicited]
          destination link-address option (2), length 8 (1): d4:af:f7:0f:95:0c
```
the interval between the neighbor solicitation received from ptf and the advertisement is 6 seconds

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
`test_proxy_arp` ipv6 failed on t0-backend nightlies.
The failure is because the interval between the neighbor solicitation and advertisement packet is larger than the verification timeout.

Signed-off-by: Longxiang Lyu <lolv@microsoft.com>

#### How did you do it?
1. increase the verification timeout
2. for t0-backend, the ptf interface to do IO should be `eth%d.1000` other than `eth%d`, so let's retrieve the ptf port name from the `iface_map` initialized by `ptfadapter`
